author: reek
body: Two copies of a selection loop is how one of them ends up with a stub sort-by-fitness again, which is exactly what happened here once: the stub returned the population unchanged, so the GA bred, mutated, reported a best-of-generation, and selected on nothing at all.

author: reek
body: sort-by-fitness reorders the population so the fittest personalities come first. Population index i pairs with scores index i. It is now one line over ga-rank; the selection sort it used to carry, and the three helpers under it, were the duplicate. The pop-size argument was never read and is kept only so callers do not move.
